content.json: Alle HTTP-Requests der Web-App ohne Health Checks und ohne Aufrufe im Admin-Bereich über SignalR. Ein Fehler ist ein Status ab 500. 4xx zählt nicht als Fehler.

content.query:
AppRequests
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where not(Name startswith "Microsoft.AspNetCore.Components.Server")
| summarize Requests = sum(ItemCount), P50 = percentilew(DurationMs, ItemCount, 50), P95 = percentilew(DurationMs, ItemCount, 95), Fehler = sumif(ItemCount, toint(ResultCode) >= 500)
| extend Rate = iff(Requests == 0, 0.0, round(100.0 * Fehler / Requests, 2))
| extend Exceptions = toscalar(AppExceptions | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange} | summarize sum(ItemCount))
| project Kennzahl = pack_array("Requests", "Latenz P50 (ms)", "Latenz P95 (ms)", "Fehler 5xx", "Fehlerquote 5xx (%)", "Exceptions"),
          Wert = pack_array(Requests, round(P50, 0), round(P95, 0), Fehler, Rate, Exceptions)
| mv-expand Kennzahl to typeof(string), Wert to typeof(real)
content.title: Übersicht
Tageslimit der Logs (150 MB, Reset 14:00 UTC)

content.query:
AppRequests
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where not(Name startswith "Microsoft.AspNetCore.Components.Server")
| summarize Requests = sum(ItemCount) by bin(TimeGenerated, {TimeRange:grain}), Status = strcat(substring(ResultCode, 0, 1), "xx")
| order by TimeGenerated asc
content.title: Requests nach Status

content.query:
AppRequests
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where not(Name startswith "Microsoft.AspNetCore.Components.Server")
| where Name startswith "GET /"
| summarize percentilesw(DurationMs, ItemCount, 50, 95, 99) by bin(TimeGenerated, {TimeRange:grain})
| project TimeGenerated, P50 = percentile_DurationMs_50, P95 = percentile_DurationMs_95, P99 = percentile_DurationMs_99
| order by TimeGenerated asc
content.title: Latenz der Seiten (ms)

content.query:
AppRequests
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where not(Name startswith "Microsoft.AspNetCore.Components.Server")
| summarize Fehler = sumif(ItemCount, toint(ResultCode) >= 500), Requests = sum(ItemCount) by bin(TimeGenerated, {TimeRange:grain})
| project TimeGenerated, ["Fehler 5xx"] = Fehler
| order by TimeGenerated asc
content.title: Fehler 5xx

content.query:
AppRequests
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where not(Name startswith "Microsoft.AspNetCore.Components.Server")
| where toint(ResultCode) >= 500
| summarize Anzahl = sum(ItemCount), Zuletzt = max(TimeGenerated), Beispiel = take_any(Url) by Endpoint = Name, Status = ResultCode
| order by Zuletzt desc
content.title: Fehler 5xx nach Endpoint

content.query:
AppExceptions
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| summarize Anzahl = sum(ItemCount), Zuletzt = max(TimeGenerated), Meldung = take_any(OuterMessage) by Typ = ExceptionType, Quelle = tostring(Properties.CategoryName)
| order by Zuletzt desc
| take 50
content.title: Exceptions

content.query:
AppRequests
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where not(Name startswith "Microsoft.AspNetCore.Components.Server")
| summarize Requests = sum(ItemCount), P50 = round(percentilew(DurationMs, ItemCount, 50), 0), P95 = round(percentilew(DurationMs, ItemCount, 95), 0), Max = round(max(DurationMs), 0), ["5xx"] = sumif(ItemCount, toint(ResultCode) >= 500) by Endpoint = Name
| top 25 by Requests desc
content.title: Endpoints nach Anzahl Requests

content.json: **Prognose-Lauf** täglich 04:30 (voll) und 13:00 (Wetter und Messwerte). **Abfluss-Job** alle 30 Minuten. Der Start eines Laufs stammt aus der RunId (UUID v7). Fehlt ein Lauf, prüfe im Tab «Kosten» das Tageslimit der Logs.

content.title: Prognose-Lauf

content.query:
let failed = AppExceptions
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where tostring(Properties.CategoryName) endswith "ForecastWorker"
| project Ende = TimeGenerated, Status = "Failed", Meldung = OuterMessage;
AppTraces
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where Message matches regex @"^Forecast run [0-9a-fA-F-]+: " or Message startswith "Forecast run failed"
| extend RunId = tostring(Properties.RunId)
| project Ende = TimeGenerated, RunId, Status = coalesce(tostring(Properties.Status), "Failed"), ["Plätze"] = toint(Properties.Sites), ["Übersprungen"] = tostring(Properties.Skipped), Meldung = Message
| union failed
| extend Start = iff(isnotempty(RunId), unixtime_milliseconds_todatetime(tolong(strcat("0x", substring(replace_string(RunId, "-", ""), 0, 12)))), datetime(null))
| extend ["Dauer (min)"] = round((Ende - Start) / 1m, 1)
| project Start = Start, Ende = Ende, ["Dauer (min)"], Status, ["Plätze"], ["Übersprungen"], RunId, Meldung
| order by Ende desc
content.title: Prognose-Läufe

content.query:
union AppTraces, AppExceptions
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where tostring(Properties.CategoryName) endswith "DischargeWorker"
| extend Status = case(
    Type == "AppExceptions" or tostring(Properties.Failed) == "True", "Fehlgeschlagen",
    tostring(Properties.Skipped) == "True", "Übersprungen",
    toint(Properties.Missing) > 0, "Teilweise",
    "Erfolgreich")
| summarize ["Läufe"] = count() by bin(TimeGenerated, {TimeRange:grain}), Status
| order by TimeGenerated asc
content.title: Abfluss-Job: Läufe

content.query:
AppDependencies
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where DependencyType == "HTTP" and Success == false
| summarize Fehler = sum(ItemCount) by bin(TimeGenerated, {TimeRange:grain}), Quelle = Target
| order by TimeGenerated asc
content.title: Externe Quellen: fehlgeschlagene Calls

content.query:
AppDependencies
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where DependencyType == "HTTP"
| summarize Calls = sum(ItemCount), Fehler = sumif(ItemCount, Success == false), ["429"] = sumif(ItemCount, ResultCode == "429"), ["P50 (ms)"] = round(percentilew(DurationMs, ItemCount, 50), 0), ["P95 (ms)"] = round(percentilew(DurationMs, ItemCount, 95), 0), Zuletzt = max(TimeGenerated) by Quelle = Target
| extend ["Fehlerquote (%)"] = round(100.0 * Fehler / Calls, 1)
| project Quelle, Calls, Fehler, ["Fehlerquote (%)"], ["429"], ["P50 (ms)"], ["P95 (ms)"], Zuletzt
| order by Calls desc
content.title: Externe Quellen

content.query:
union AppTraces, AppExceptions
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where tostring(Properties.CategoryName) endswith "DischargeWorker"
| extend Status = case(
    Type == "AppExceptions" or tostring(Properties.Failed) == "True", "Fehlgeschlagen",
    tostring(Properties.Skipped) == "True", "Übersprungen",
    toint(Properties.Missing) > 0, "Teilweise",
    "Erfolgreich")
| project Zeit = TimeGenerated, Status, Stationen = toint(Properties.Stations), ["Ohne Werte"] = toint(Properties.Missing), ["Neue Vorhersagen"] = toint(Properties.Forecasts), Meldung = coalesce(OuterMessage, Message)
| order by Zeit desc
| take 50
content.title: Abfluss-Job: letzte Läufe

content.query:
union AppTraces, AppExceptions
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| extend Quelle = tostring(Properties.CategoryName)
| where Quelle has_any ("MediaPurgeWorker", "MailQueueWorker", "ProcessMailQueue")
| where Type == "AppExceptions" or SeverityLevel >= 2 or Message startswith "Media purge"
| project Zeit = TimeGenerated, Job = tostring(split(Quelle, ".")[-1]), Stufe = iff(Type == "AppExceptions", "Fehler", case(SeverityLevel >= 3, "Fehler", SeverityLevel == 2, "Warnung", "Info")), Meldung = coalesce(OuterMessage, Message)
| order by Zeit desc
| take 50
content.title: Fotos löschen und Mail-Queue

content.json: Azure SQL **Basic**: 5 DTU, 2 GB. Hält die DTU-Auslastung lange über 80 %, wird die Website langsam. Die Calls unten sieht die App selbst (alle SQL-Befehle über EF Core).

content.query:
AppDependencies
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where DependencyType == "SQL"
| summarize Calls = sum(ItemCount), Fehler = sumif(ItemCount, Success == false) by bin(TimeGenerated, {TimeRange:grain})
| order by TimeGenerated asc
content.title: SQL-Calls der App

content.query:
AppDependencies
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where DependencyType == "SQL"
| summarize percentilesw(DurationMs, ItemCount, 50, 95, 99) by bin(TimeGenerated, {TimeRange:grain})
| project TimeGenerated, P50 = percentile_DurationMs_50, P95 = percentile_DurationMs_95, P99 = percentile_DurationMs_99
| order by TimeGenerated asc
content.title: Dauer der SQL-Calls (ms)

content.query:
AppDependencies
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where DependencyType == "SQL"
| join kind=leftouter (AppRequests | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange} | project OperationId, Request = Name) on OperationId
| extend Herkunft = coalesce(Request, "Job / Hintergrund")
| summarize Calls = sum(ItemCount), ["Total (s)"] = round(sum(DurationMs * ItemCount) / 1000, 1), ["P95 (ms)"] = round(percentilew(DurationMs, ItemCount, 95), 0), Fehler = sumif(ItemCount, Success == false) by Herkunft
| top 20 by ["Total (s)"] desc
content.title: SQL-Last nach Herkunft

content.json:
### Log-Volumen
Tageslimit 150 MB (0.15 GB) pro Tag ab 14:00 UTC. Danach nimmt Log Analytics bis zum nächsten Reset nichts mehr an. Dann fehlen Requests, Jobs und Alerts.

content.query:
Usage
| where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
| where IsBillable
| summarize MB = sum(Quantity) by TimeGenerated = bin(TimeGenerated - 14h, 1d) + 14h, Tabelle = DataType
| order by TimeGenerated asc
content.title: Log-Volumen pro Tag ab Reset 14:00 UTC (MB, 30 Tage)

content.query:
_LogOperation
| where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
| where Category == "Ingestion" and Detail has "daily limit"
| project Zeit = TimeGenerated, Ereignis = iff(Detail has "stopped", "Gestoppt: Tageslimit erreicht", "Wieder gestartet"), Detail
| order by Zeit desc
content.title: Tageslimit erreicht

content.json:
Nur Seitenaufrufe mit Status 200, ohne Dateien, Weiterleitungen und 404. Ohne Cookies und ohne IP-Adresse: Die Zahlen zählen Aufrufe, nicht Personen.

- **Bot (erkannt):** Application Insights erkennt den Bot, oder der Client ist ein Skript (curl, Python, …).
- **Bot (Verdacht):** veraltetes System (Android bis 7, iOS bis 14) oder ein Browser mehr als 12 Versionen hinter dem neuesten. Crawler tarnen sich oft so, z.B. der Googlebot für Smartphones als Android 6.
- Ein iPad meldet sich als Mac und zählt als Desktop.

content.query:
let window = AppRequests
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange};
let browserMax = AppRequests
| where TimeGenerated > ago(30d) and isempty(SyntheticSource)
| extend Family = extract(@"^(.+?) \d", 1, ClientBrowser), Major = toint(extract(@" (\d+)", 1, ClientBrowser))
| summarize MaxMajor = max(Major) by Family;
let pages = window
| where Name startswith "GET /" and ResultCode == "200"
| where not(Name has_any ("/not-found", "/robots.txt", "/sitemap", "/health", "/alive", "/api/", "/admin", "/platform"))
| extend Family = extract(@"^(.+?) \d", 1, ClientBrowser), Major = toint(extract(@" (\d+)", 1, ClientBrowser))
| lookup kind=leftouter browserMax on Family
| extend Besucher = case(
    isnotempty(SyntheticSource)
      or ClientBrowser in ("Other", "")
      or ClientBrowser matches regex @"(?i)bot|crawl|spider|slurp|curl|wget|python|go-http|java|okhttp|axios|node|headless|scrapy|http.?client|libwww|php|ruby|perl|postman|insomnia", "Bot (erkannt)",
    ClientOS matches regex @"^Android [1-7](\.|$)"
      or ClientOS matches regex @"^iOS (\d|1[0-4])\."
      or (Family in ("Chrome", "Chrome Mobile", "Chrome Mobile iOS", "Edge", "Firefox", "Firefox Mobile", "Opera") and Major < MaxMajor - 12), "Bot (Verdacht)",
    "Mensch")
| extend Geraet = case(
    Besucher != "Mensch", "Bot",
    ClientOS startswith "iOS" or (ClientOS startswith "Android" and not(ClientBrowser matches regex @"^(Chrome|Firefox|Edge|Samsung Internet|Opera) \d")), "Mobile",
    ClientOS startswith "Android", "Tablet",
    "Desktop");
pages
| summarize Menschen = sumif(ItemCount, Besucher == "Mensch"), Erkannt = sumif(ItemCount, Besucher == "Bot (erkannt)"), Verdacht = sumif(ItemCount, Besucher == "Bot (Verdacht)"), Tage = dcount(bin(TimeGenerated, 1d))
| extend Anteil = iff(Menschen + Erkannt + Verdacht == 0, 0.0, round(100.0 * Menschen / (Menschen + Erkannt + Verdacht), 1))
| project Kennzahl = pack_array("Seitenaufrufe Menschen", "Ø pro Tag (Menschen)", "Bots (erkannt)", "Bots (Verdacht)", "Anteil Menschen (%)"),
          Wert = pack_array(Menschen, round(1.0 * Menschen / max_of(Tage, 1), 0), Erkannt, Verdacht, Anteil)
| mv-expand Kennzahl to typeof(string), Wert to typeof(real)
content.title: Übersicht
